questions.question: Which type of liverworts form umbrella-shaped structures that raise gametangia above the main gametophyte body and sporophytes develop below these structures?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Marchantia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Liverworts:-**

 
 
• These are **non-vascular plants** that belong to the **phylum Hepatophyta**.
 
• The **umbrella-shaped** structures that raise gametangia above the main gametophyte body are known as **archegoniophores**.
 
• These archegoniophores are found in the** genus Marchantia**.
 
 
 
• **Marchantia:-**
 
 
• **It is a genus of liverworts, which are a type of non-vascular plant often found in moist and damp environments. **
 
• Liverworts belong to the division Marchantiophyta and are some of the earliest land plants to have evolved.
 
• Marchantia liverworts are small, flat, and leafy plants that typically grow in low, spreading mats.
 
• They have a distinctive appearance with flattened, lobed structures that resemble tiny leaves.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fed59453036d61d8cf924259a021a75914dbf3c8796a440f714d99e0a6a81e0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polytrichum:-**

 
 
• It​ also known as **haircap moss**, is a type of moss that forms **dense cushions or tufts** in moist habitats.
 
 
 
• **Funaria:-**
 
 
• It​ is also known as **cord moss**, is a common type of moss that is found in **moist, shaded habitats.**
 
 
 
• **Sphagnum:-**
 
 
• It is also known as **peat moss**, is a type of moss that is found in **wetlands and bogs** and is known for its ability to **store water.**

questions.question: In Five year plans, Plan Holiday is from ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1966-1969.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plan Holiday:-**

 
 
• It​ was a **break** in the **Five Year Plans of India**, during which** no new plan** was launched.
 
• It was from** 1966 to 1969** when the **third plan ended** and the** fourth plan began.**
 
• The break was taken to evaluate the** progress** of the previous plans and to make **necessary changes **in the upcoming plan.
 
• The decision to take a Plan Holiday was made by the then** Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi.**
 
• The Plan Holiday helped in** improving the economy** and **reducing poverty **in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Five-Year Plans:-**

 
 
• **It refer to the country's series of comprehensive economic development strategies. **
 
• The planning process was initiated by the Planning Commission (and later replaced by NITI Aayog).
 
• Each plan outlined the government's priorities, sectoral allocations, and development goals for a five-year period.
 
• The concept of five-year plans was popularized by the Soviet Union under Joseph Stalin's leadership. The Soviets used these plans to rapidly industrialize and develop the economy.

• **He attended the Second Round Table Conference.**

• It was held in **London **from **September to December 1931.**
 
• The conference was convened by the **British government** to discuss** constitutional reforms** in India.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi attended the conference as the** sole representative** of the **Indian National Congress **(INC).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: What is the total number of rivers including tributaries in Bangladesh?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**About 700.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bangladesh has around 700 rivers and tributaries, which cover a total length of over 24,000 km and provide a vital source of water for agriculture, fisheries, and other economic activities.
 
• Bangladesh is a country with a **complex network of rivers and tributaries**, which crisscross the country and provide an essential means of **transportation, irrigation, and livelihood **for millions of people.
 
• The major rivers in Bangladesh are the **Brahmaputra, the Ganges, and the Meghna,** which are all** transboundary rivers** that originate from the **Himalayas** and flow through India before entering **Bangladesh.**
 
• Apart from these major rivers, Bangladesh has numerous other rivers and tributaries, which form an** intricate network of waterways** that covers almost every part of the country.
 
• The exact number of rivers and tributaries in Bangladesh is** difficult to determine,** as it depends on various factors such as the size of the river, its flow, and the criteria used to define a river or tributary.

• The Theosophical Society aimed to promote the study of **comparative religion, philosophy, and science, **and to investigate the unexplained laws of nature and the powers latent in humanity.
 
• Besant believed that ancient **Indian wisdom** had much to offer the world, and she worked tirelessly to promote the **study of Hinduism, Buddhism,** and other **Eastern religions** through the Theosophical Society.
 
• She also co-authored a book called **'The Secret Doctrine'** with the founder of **Theosophical Society, Madame Blavatsky, **which explored the origins of the universe and humanity's place in it.

• Although Arya Samaj promoted the study of ancient Indian religions, it **did not **have a significant influence on Annie Besant's work.

questions.question: In February 2022, the Delhi High Court reserved judgement on a series of Public Interest Litigations (PILs) challenging which exception in Section 375 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Marital rape.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **PILs challenge** the **exception clause** in **Section 375** which **excludes marital rape** from the definition of rape.
 
• The challenge is significant as it could lead to the** criminalization of marital rape** and provide more protection to women against **sexual violence within marriage.**
 
• **Physical torture, dowry death, and suicide** are **not exceptions** in Section 375, but they are related to crimes against women in India.
 
• **Physical torture and dowry death** are often associated with** domestic violence **and **dowry-related crimes, r**espectively.
 
• Suicide is **not a crime**, but it is often linked to **mental health issues** and **social pressures** faced by women in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Section 375 **of the Indian Penal Code deals with the **offence of rape.**
 
• The exception being challenged in the** PILs is the exception clause **which states that sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being **under fifteen years of age,** is not rape.
 
• **Marital rape** refers to any **unwanted sexual acts** by a spouse or ex-spouse that is committed **without the other person's consent.**
 
• **Physical torture** refers to any act of violence that causes** physical harm or injury** to a person.
 
• **Dowry death** refers to the **murder or suicide of a woman** who is unable to meet the demands of her husband or his family for a dowry.

questions.question: Goods and Service Tax is an example of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**indirect tax.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goods and Service Tax (GST)** is a type of** indirect tax** that is levied on the** sale of goods and services.**
 
• It is an example of an **indirect tax** because it is **not directly paid by the consumer** to the government, but rather collected by **businesses** and then** remitted** to the government.
 
• **GST** was introduced in India in **2017** to replace** multiple indirect taxes** such as **excise duty, service tax, and value-added tax (VAT).**
 
• The aim was to simplify the tax system and create a **single, unified tax structure.**
 
• The GST system has **different tax rates** for different goods and services, ranging from **0% to 28%.**
 
• There are four tax slabs **- 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% -** with essential goods and services attracting lower rates and luxury items attracting higher rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Compensation to employees **is a payment made by an **employer to an employee** in return for their work. It is** not related** to GST.
 
• **Direct tax **is a tax that is paid directly by an** individual or organization** to the government, such as income tax or corporate tax. GST is **not** a direct tax.
 
• **Transfer payment **is a type of payment made by the **government to individuals or organizations **without any goods or services being exchanged.
 
 
• Examples include **social security** benefits and welfare payments. This is also** not r**elated to GST.
 
 
 
• Hence, the **correct **answer is option 4 - GST is an example of an indirect tax.

questions.question: What type of vegetation is found in the plateau of Meghalaya, Sahyadri and the central and southern islands of the Nicobar group?

• This type of climate supports the** growth of moist tropical vegetation.**
 
• Moist Tropical Semi-Evergreen Vegetation is a type of vegetation that is characterized by** trees that shed their leaves partially **during the** dry season.**
 
• This allows the trees to** conserve wate**r and survive during the dry season.
 
• The vegetation is also characterized by the presence of** epiphytes, lianas, and ferns.**

• This type of vegetation is found in regions with a** tropical climate** and a **distinct dry season.**
 
• Trees in this vegetation shed all their leaves during the **dry season** to** conserve water.**
 
• This type of vegetation is** not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Dry Tropical Thorny Vegetation**:
 
 
• This type of vegetation is found in regions with a **tropical climate** and **low rainfall**.
 
• The vegetation is characterized by the presence of** thorny shrubs and trees**.
 
• This type of vegetation is** not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Alpine Vegetation:**
 
 
• This type of vegetation is found in **high-altitude regions **where the** temperature is low** and the** climate is harsh. **
 
• This type of vegetation is **not** found in the regions mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "the correct answer is option 4" is **correct.**

questions.question: In case an Indian citizen is arrested and denied the right to be defended, then in such a situation, which Article of the Indian Constitution can provide a relief?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 22.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 22** of the Indian Constitution provides relief to an** Indian citizen **who is arrested and denied the** right to be defended.**
 
• **Article 22(1) **provides that every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be informed of the grounds of such arrest and shall be allowed to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of his choice
 
• **Article 22(2) states** that every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be produced before the nearest magistrate within a period of 24 hours of such arrest.
 
• **Article 22(4**) states that **no law** providing for preventive detention shall authorise the** detention of a person** for a longer period than **three months** unless an Advisory Board has reported before the expiration of the said period that there is, in its opinion,** sufficient cause** for such detention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 23 **deals with the prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour.
 
• **Article 24** prohibits the employment of children in factories, etc.
 
• **Article 25 **deals with freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion.
 
• Hence, the statement 1 is** correct.**

questions.question: Which of the following helps the coffee flowers to blossom in Karnataka?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Blossom shower.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blossom shower** is a weather phenomenon that occurs in** Karnataka **during the months of **February and March**, which helps the coffee flowers to blossom.
 
• This shower is a combination of **light rain and sunshine**, which is essential for the growth of** coffee flowers.**
 
• These pre-monsoon showers are **critical for the timely blossoming of coffee flowers** and the subsequent development of the beans.
 
• A good Blossom shower is integral to the** yield and quality** of the coffee crop for the season.
 
• Absence or inadequate Blossom showers can negatively impact the coffee yield.
 
• It is a localized weather occurrence prevalent in the** Western Ghats region of India.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nor'westers **are thunderstorms that occur in the **northern and eastern parts** of India during the summer months, and they do not have any impact on the coffee flowers in Karnataka.
 
• **Loo** is a **hot and dry wind **that blows across the **northern and central parts** of India during the summer months, and it is not related to the growth of coffee flowers.
 
• **Mango shower **is a **pre-monsoon rain** that occurs in the **southern parts **of India during the months of April and May, and it is not related to the growth of coffee flowers.

questions.question: On August 15, 2022, India celebrated its ________ Independence Day from the British rule.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**76th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India celebrated its **76th Independence Day** on **August 15, 2022**, marking the day when the country gained freedom from British colonial rule in 1947.
 
• The day is a **national holiday** and is celebrated with great enthusiasm across the country, with **flag-hoisting ceremonies**, parades, cultural programs, and patriotic speeches.
 
• The first Independence Day was celebrated on **August 15, 1947**, when India's first Prime Minister,** Jawaharlal Nehru,** raised the national flag at the **Red Fort **in Delhi and delivered his famous speech** "Tryst with Destiny."**
 
• The struggle for India's independence was a** long and arduous one,** led by freedom fighters like **Mahatma Gandhi, Subhash Chandra Bose, Bhagat Singh,** and many others who sacrificed their lives for the cause.

questions.question: Tila, Seti and Beri are the tributaries of:
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is 'Ghaghara'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghaghara River:**

 
 
• The Ghaghara, known as **Karnali in Nepal**, is a major left-bank tributary of the Ganga.
 
• It originates near **Mansarovar Lake in Tibet** and flows through Nepal before entering India.
 
• In India, it flows through **Uttar Pradesh and Bihar** and finally joins the Ganga at **Chhapra**.
 
• **Tila, Seti, and Beri** are its important tributaries in Nepal, making Ghaghara the correct answer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Tamsa River:**

 
 
• Also known as the **Tons River**, it is a tributary of the Ganga.
 
• It originates from the **Tamsa Kund** in the **Kaimur range** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• After a hilly journey of about **64 km**, it enters the plains and is joined by the **Belan River**.
 
• It merges with the **Ganga near Sirsa**, about 32 km from Prayagraj (U.P.).
 
• The Tamsa is historically significant, as traditions associate it with Lord Rama’s exile journey.
 
• However, it does not have tributaries like Tila, Seti, and Beri, so it is not the correct answer.
 
 
 
• **Mahi River:**
 
 
• Originates in Madhya Pradesh, flows through Rajasthan and Gujarat, and drains into the Arabian Sea.
 
• Its tributaries include Som and Anas, not Tila, Seti, or Beri.
 
 
 
• **Sabarmati River:**
 
 
• Originates from the Aravalli Hills in Rajasthan and flows into Gujarat before meeting the Arabian Sea.
 
• Its tributaries include Hathmati, Wakal, and Sei, not Tila, Seti, or Beri.

questions.question: The National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022 was awarded to Aparna Satheesan for which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022** was awarded to **Aparna Satheesan** for the **Kuchipudi dance form.**
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements, intricate footwork,** and expressive **facial expressions.**
 
• The other options mentioned in the question are also classical Indian dance forms, but they are **different from Kuchipudi **in terms of their origin, style, and repertoire.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance form from **Tamil Nadu, Kathakali** is a dance-drama from **Kerala,** and **Odissi** is a classical dance form from **Odisha.**
